source_title: ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager Help: Property IDs
material_use: Supports the distinction among Portfolio Manager Property IDs, Parent Property IDs, user-defined Custom IDs and external Standard IDs.
limitations: ENERGY STAR benchmarking guidance is not a self-storage master-data standard and does not prescribe this article's internal key or crosswalk design.

publisher: Federal Real Property Council / U.S. General Services Administration
provenance: Current official FY 2026 federal real-property inventory guidance
material_use: Supports the control pattern of a unique real-property identifier used for linkage to other systems and retained over time rather than reused.
limitations: Federal inventory reporting requirements do not govern private self-storage operators; the article uses the identifier pattern as an authoritative design example only.

material_use: Supports the example of a physical location identified with a unique fixed-length Global Location Number.
limitations: GLN is a GS1 identification standard. The article does not claim that a self-storage operator must license or adopt GLNs.

publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
material_use: Supports asset-management governance, inventories of data and metadata, accountable ownership and lifecycle handling as general control patterns.
